svg.title: Spoke to spoke goes through vm-router
svg.desc: vm-spoke1's request for spoke 2 follows rt-spoke1 (spoke 2's /20, next hop vm-router) over the hub peering to vm-router, which forwards it over the other peering to vm-spoke2. The reply follows rt-spoke2 back through the router. The spokes are not peered with each other, so without the routes there is no way through.
